text:
Halvorsen Mott has won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, the Okarra Regional Transport Authority announced on 14 March 2025.

Delphine Arkwright, the Authority's Director of Infrastructure, confirmed the selection to reporters at the announcement. She said the decision followed a full review of the bids by the Authority's procurement board.

The contract is valued at 218 million credits, with completion scheduled within 31 months of the award.

The board's reasoning is set out in Tender Evaluation Report OTA-2025/07, which the Authority has published. This newspaper has read the report, which names Halvorsen Mott as the successful bidder.

Ms Arkwright said the Authority would release further details on the construction programme as the work is organised. Residents who rely on the crossing can expect that information to follow.
